About this item

  • EYE-CARING LED DESK LAMP: The SUPERDANNY gooseneck clamp-on desk lamp has a unique 60° lighting angle that prevents direct light from shining into your eyes. It features 54 high-quality LED chips that provide even, no-flicker soft light, reducing eye strain even during long use. This lamp enhances focus and productivity, making it ideal for working on important documents or detailed crafting.
  • BRIGHT & WIDE-AREA LIGHTING: This clamp-on desk lamp is a game changer. Its 16-inch long light head delivers 500 lumens of brightness, illuminating the entire surface of a 60-inch computer desk or workbench. It’s perfect for tasks like working from home, crafting, drawing blueprints, nail polishing, quilting, and diamond painting. Brighter light leads to a brighter future.
  • EASY SETUP AND CONTROL: Setting up the lamp is simple and needs just 3 steps: connect the screws, clamp it to your desk, and plug it in. Unlike other lamps with a dangling controller cord, this lamp has touch-control buttons embedded on the lamp head for easy access. A clear instruction manual is included and our helpful customer service is always here to help.
  • 3 LIGHT COLORS & DIMMABLE: The LED reading lamp offers three light colors: 3000K warm white, 4500K natural white, and 6000K cool white. You can smoothly adjust the brightness from 10% to 100% at each color temperature. Customize your lighting for different tasks and moods, whether you need bright white light for detailed work or a warmer, softer glow for relaxation and reading.
  • 360°FLEXIBLE GOOSENECK: The 360° adjustable gooseneck tube allows you to position the office lamp at the exact height you need (maximum lamp height: 29 inches). Made with high-quality silicone and metal materials, this gooseneck desk lamp can bend up to 100,000 times without breaking. The clamp lamp has a silicone pad to prevent scratching the table.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

About this Item

  • EYE-CARING LED DESK LAMP: The SUPERDANNY gooseneck clamp-on desk lamp has a unique 60° lighting angle that prevents direct light from shining into your eyes. It features 54 high-quality LED chips that provide even, no-flicker soft light, reducing eye strain even during long use. This lamp enhances focus and productivity, making it ideal for working on important documents or detailed crafting.
  • BRIGHT & WIDE-AREA LIGHTING: This clamp-on desk lamp is a game changer. Its 16-inch long light head delivers 500 lumens of brightness, illuminating the entire surface of a 60-inch computer desk or workbench. It’s perfect for tasks like working from home, crafting, drawing blueprints, nail polishing, quilting, and diamond painting. Brighter light leads to a brighter future.
  • EASY SETUP AND CONTROL: Setting up the lamp is simple and needs just 3 steps: connect the screws, clamp it to your desk, and plug it in. Unlike other lamps with a dangling controller cord, this lamp has touch-control buttons embedded on the lamp head for easy access. A clear instruction manual is included and our helpful customer service is always here to help.
  • 3 LIGHT COLORS & DIMMABLE: The LED reading lamp offers three light colors: 3000K warm white, 4500K natural white, and 6000K cool white. You can smoothly adjust the brightness from 10% to 100% at each color temperature. Customize your lighting for different tasks and moods, whether you need bright white light for detailed work or a warmer, softer glow for relaxation and reading.
  • 360°FLEXIBLE GOOSENECK: The 360° adjustable gooseneck tube allows you to position the office lamp at the exact height you need (maximum lamp height: 29 inches). Made with high-quality silicone and metal materials, this gooseneck desk lamp can bend up to 100,000 times without breaking. The clamp lamp has a silicone pad to prevent scratching the table.
